items.title: Southwest Natural Gas Cash Tops $8 as Southern California Supply Runs Short
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices climbed at most hubs Thursday as a Southern California supply shortage warning sent Arizona cash nearly $3 higher, while heavy rain took the edge off Gulf Coast premiums.

items.title: Southeast Natural Gas Basis Spreads Widen as Late-Summer Demand Pressures Pipes
items.summary: September natural gas basis across the Southeast has strengthened sharply relative to October as lingering cooling demand keeps pressure on pipeline systems already running near capacity.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Gain as Storage Surplus Shrinks, Freeport LNG Demand Rebounds
items.summary: Natural gas futures moved higher Thursday, supported by a lean storage injection and rising feedgas demand from the Freeport LNG terminal, though sellers trimmed a morning rally at technical resistance.

items.title: Freeport LNG Completes Major Maintenance
items.summary: Freeport LNG feedgas nominations neared 2 Bcf/d Thursday, returning roughly 0.8 Bcf/d of demand to the Gulf Coast just as summer heat lingers into September.

items.title: Westcoast Constraints Cut Canadian Natural Gas Imports, Lift Northwest Sumas Prices
items.summary: Sustained capacity constraints on Westcoast Energy’s T-South system have tightened western Canadian imports into the Pacific Northwest, lifting regional prices.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Advance; California Supply Squeeze Jolts Midday Cash Above $8
items.summary: Natural gas futures pulled back from earlier highs around midday Thursday but remained supported by a lean storage build, including another hefty South Central salt withdrawal and stronger LNG feedgas.

items.title: TotalEnergies Transfers Stake in Russia’s Arctic LNG 2 to Novatek Affiliate
items.summary: TotalEnergies said Thursday it has completed its exit from the Arctic LNG 2 facility in Russia’s Far North, transferring its 10% interest fully to PAO Novatek subsidiary Nordline.

items.title: Sapphire Expands Mobile LNG Footprint With EDGE Acquisition
items.summary: Conroe, TX-based Sapphire Gas Solutions has acquired EDGE LNG, adding about 200,000 gallons/day of modular liquefaction capacity as it expands its vertically integrated LNG supply business.

items.title: Anemic Storage Print Supports Natural Gas Futures, Though Profit Taking Slows Momentum
